slots.name: UNIFIL mandate end date
slots.sentence: U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres has responded to the Security Council’s request for options for U.N. monitoring and observations, following the end of the U.N. Interim Force in Lebanon’s mandate in December.

slots.name: UNIFIL force size
slots.sentence: The Security Council met behind closed doors Friday and discussed a request by Lebanon’s government to extend the mandate for the 8,100-member force, which is supposed to end on Dec. 31, the two diplomats with knowledge of the discussion said.
